why: Multiple post-snapshot sources report that specific longstanding potential counterexamples to the (stable) Andrews-Curtis conjecture, including the Akbulut-Kirby AK(3) presentation and several Miller-Schupp presentations, were shown AC-trivializable (i.e. eliminated as counterexamples) via AI/RL-assisted search (DeepMind/Caltech collaboration, Aug 2024) and follow-up automated-deduction work (Jan 2025).

found.title: New Andrews–Curtis trivializations for Miller–Schupp group presentations
found.note: Reports AI/RL-found AC-trivializations for families of Miller-Schupp presentations previously considered potential counterexamples.

found.title: AI Program Plays the Long Game to Solve Decades-Old Math Problems
found.note: Caltech/DeepMind announcement describing an RL agent trivializing large families of long-standing potential counterexamples to the Andrews-Curtis conjecture.

found.title: Stable Andrews-Curtis trivialization of AK(3) revisited. A case study using automated deduction
found.note: Follow-up automated-deduction paper re-deriving/analyzing the stable trivialization of the AK(3) presentation.
